entries.reachability_signal: Output contains 'Failed to read int token.' when config has invalid integer values; or successfully dumps config when values are valid
entries.expected_signal: Old behavior accepts non-numeric/trailing-char ints silently; new behavior rejects them with 'Failed to read int token.'
entries.input_strategy: Create config files with TOK_INT values: (a) valid integer '777', (b) non-numeric 'abc', (c) trailing chars '123abc', (d) special creation_time ERANGE case. Compare before (unpatched) vs after (patched) behavior.
entries.limitations: Cannot test kernel device-mapper backed operations. Testing only userspace config parsing via dumpconfig. The _type() parse path is reached when lvm reads config files during any command.
